description: Error-check facts describe one value of err. A later `_, err = ...` is a new value whose own check is reachable, and `err == nil` / `err != nil` state opposite facts, so neither prunes the branch. Repeating the same check on the same value is still infeasible.

expected.notes: err was redefined by os.Stat; its error branch is reachable
after `err == nil` returns, err is non-nil, so `err != nil` holds
the first `err != nil` returned, so the second one cannot hold
